findings.issue: OVER-SUPPRESSION: 'an unformatted connection has no changeable modes' (12.5.2 p1) was recorded as having no portable oracle. It is portably observable: INQUIRE BLANK=, DECIMAL=, DELIM=, LEADING_ZERO=, PAD=, ROUND= and SIGN= must return UNDEFINED for a connection not for formatted I/O (12.10.2.6/.7/.8/.15/.21/.28/.30).
findings.resolution: Concrete plan with OPENED= and FORM= established first and sentinel-prefilled INQUIRE variables expecting UNDEFINED.

findings.issue: The C1202 negative was conditional on a processor offering an unsupported character kind.
findings.resolution: Recorded as source-only: no character kind outside default, ASCII and ISO 10646 is guaranteed (7.4.4.1, 16.9.180); a non-character variable fails R1203 first and a vector-subscripted section reaches C1201, so no portable one-property C1202 negative exists.
